job.job_description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a highly motivated and innovative AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions for web, mobile, enterprise, and eCommerce platforms. The candidate will work closely with developers, UI/UX teams, business analysts, and stakeholders to build intelligent systems including chatbots, recommendation engines, predictive analytics, automation workflows, and generative AI applications.

Key Responsibilities

AI/ML Development

Design, develop, and implement AI and Machine Learning models.
Build NLP-based applications such as chatbots, virtual assistants, and AI search.
Develop recommendation engines for eCommerce and service platforms.
Train, fine-tune, and optimize AI models for performance and scalability.
Work with Generative AI technologies including LLMs and AI APIs.

Data Engineering & Processing

Collect, clean, and preprocess structured and unstructured datasets.
Create data pipelines for AI model training and inference.
Work with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search.

Integration & Deployment

Integrate AI models into websites, mobile applications, and enterprise systems.
Deploy AI services using cloud platforms and APIs.
Optimize AI systems for real-time performance and scalability.
Monitor AI models and continuously improve accuracy.

Research & Innovation

Stay updated with latest AI trends, frameworks, and tools.
Research new AI capabilities applicable to HRMS, ERP, eCommerce, CRM, and SaaS products.
Suggest AI-driven automation and optimization opportunities.

Collaboration

Coordinate with UI/UX, frontend, backend, DevOps, and project management teams.
Participate in client discussions to understand AI requirements and solution architecture.
Create technical documentation and AI workflow diagrams.

Required Skills

Technical Skills

Strong knowledge of Python and AI/ML libraries.
Experience with:
TensorFlow
PyTorch
Scikit-learn
OpenCV
Hugging Face Transformers
Knowledge of:
NLP (Natural Language Processing)
Computer Vision
Generative AI
Deep Learning
Recommendation Systems
Experience with APIs and AI integrations.
Knowledge of vector databases like Pinecone, Weaviate, or FAISS.
Understanding of REST APIs and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with cloud platforms:
AWS
Azure
Google Cloud

Database & Tools

MySQL / PostgreSQL / MongoDB
Git & GitHub
Docker & Kubernetes (Preferred)

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field.
2–5 years of experience in AI/ML development.
Experience in AI implementation for:
eCommerce platforms
HRMS software
CRM/ERP systems
Automation tools
Experience with LLMs like:
GPT
Claude
Gemini
Open-source models

Good to Have

Experience in AI agents and autonomous workflows.
Knowledge of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or RAG architecture.
Experience with voice AI and speech processing.
Exposure to MLOps pipelines and CI/CD.

KPIs / Performance Indicators

AI model accuracy and optimization.
Successful deployment of AI features.
Reduction in manual processes through automation.
Client satisfaction and delivery timelines.
Innovation and implementation of new AI capabilities.
